super6.race: Festive Fixtures At Southwell Racecourse Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
super6.comment: Modest maiden hurdler who failed to build on his reappearance when only seventh of 14 at Carlisle (17f, good) 15 days ago. With a respected stable but others arrive with more pressing claims.
Successful twice over 7f on all-weather in 2025. Well below par last 3 runs though, tried in different headgear when eleventh of 13 in 1m handicap at Kempton 20 days ago.

super6.race: 2027 Group Package Deals Online Beginners Chase
super6.comment: Showed the benefit of his initial experience over hurdles when fourth of 11 in maiden at Punchestown (3m) in June. Might have needed the run after 4 months off when fifth of 10 on Gowran chase debut (2½m, good) 17 days ago. Could have more to offer for leading stable.

finals.race: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
finals.comment: €38,000 foal, 82,000 gns yearling, Blackbeard gelding. Half-brother to winners abroad by Zoffany and Poet's Voice and 11.6f winner Venezuelan. Dam, 1m winner, half-sister to smart winner up to 10.4f Dilshaan. 6f probably sharp enough but stable more than capable of readying a newcomer.

finals.race: 2027 Annual Badge At Tramore Racecourse Maiden Hurdle
finals.comment: Has made an encouraging start in finishing second in Leopardstown bumper and Limerick maiden hurdle 22 months apart. Looks the danger to Forty Fifty if he's come out of his belated return okay.

finals.race: 2027 Annual Badge At Tramore Racecourse Maiden Hurdle
finals.comment: Half-sister to 3 winners, including useful hurdle/smart chase winner Zero Ten (2m-2½m winner). Showed only greenness in Naas bumper earlier this month.

finals.race: Winter Ladies Night Saturday 28th November Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
finals.comment: €56,000 3-y-o, It's Gino gelding. Half-brother to 5 winners, including fair hurdlers/chasers Limerick Leader and Well Done d'Oc. Showed plenty when second of 4 in a Market Rasen bumper on debut last month and the winner of that race has since run well over hurdles. Must enter calculations.

finals.race: Winter Ladies Night Saturday 28th November Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
finals.comment: Easy winner third start in Irish points but looks a handicap project on early evidence under Rules.

finals.race: All-Weather Championship Is Back Nursery
finals.comment: Is 0-7 and not proving easy to catch right, tried in cheekpieces when tenth of 13 in nursery at Southwell (6f) 19 days ago. Makes polytrack debut.

finals.race: New Years Day Discount Tickets Online Mares Maiden Hurdle
finals.comment: €62,000 3-y-o. Dam (c120/h110), 2½m hurdle/chase winner (stayed 3m), sister to useful hurdler/chaser (stayed 3¼m) Goose Man. Showed a bit of promise when 22¾ lengths third of 11 in 2½m maiden at Wexford last month but needs to find plenty of improvement.

finals.race: Winter Ladies Night Saturday 28th November Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
finals.comment: Thrived on the Flat (fairly useful form, stays 1¼m) when away from testing ground this autumn but was tailed off on his recent hurdling debut at Market Rasen and is unlikely to be of interest until handicapping.

finals.race: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
finals.comment: Fair bumper winner/maiden hurdler and showed improved/fairly useful form when narrowly denied in 11f Southwell maiden in September. Hung left going right-handed for the first time on the level at Kempton 4 weeks ago so no surprise he's quickly back to this configuration. Can get involved.

finals.race: Festive Fixtures At Southwell Racecourse Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Modest maiden hurdler who failed to build on his reappearance when only seventh of 14 at Carlisle (17f, good) 15 days ago. With a respected stable but others arrive with more pressing claims.

finals.race: ARC 1M Bonus Handicap
finals.comment: Successful twice over 7f on all-weather in 2025. Well below par last 3 runs though, tried in different headgear when eleventh of 13 in 1m handicap at Kempton 20 days ago.

finals.race: Bill Halley Outstanding Contribution Award 2026 Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
finals.comment: Winning pointer. Well held first 4 starts over hurdles but much better signs in first-time cheekpieces when fifth of 19 in handicap at Galway (3m, heavy) 29 days ago. Trainer going well so can't be ruled out. RESERVE.

finals.race: Christmas Jumper Day Sunday 13th December Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Irish point winner who was well held in a bumper in February but showed fair form when runner-up in a pair of novice hurdles at up to 2¾m in the spring. His opening handicap mark demands improvement but he brings unexposed potential.

finals.race: 2027 Group Package Deals Online Beginners Chase
finals.comment: Showed the benefit of his initial experience over hurdles when fourth of 11 in maiden at Punchestown (3m) in June. Might have needed the run after 4 months off when fifth of 10 on Gowran chase debut (2½m, good) 17 days ago. Could have more to offer for leading stable.

finals.race: Book The Bistro In Seasons Restaurant Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Irish point recruit failed to better modest form under Rules at the end of 2024, including remote third on 19f Wetherby chase and handicap debut. Off 23 months his yard's fine form makes him one to keep a close eye on in the betting. Tongue tied first time.

finals.race: Killens 'Junior' NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
Conferences And Events At Southwell Racecourse Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Finished last season with a decisive victory at Hereford (2m) and resumed progress with C&D win last month. Respectable fourth of 11 at Cheltenham since, despite a couple of jumping errors. Should go well again.

finals.race: Conferences And Events At Southwell Racecourse Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Made giant strides as a handicap hurdler in 2025. Hasn't fired at all this year but well handicapped again (3 lb below his latest winning mark) and needs monitoring in the betting with the Sam England team continuing in good form overall.

finals.race: All Weather Championship Is Back EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)
finals.comment: Zarak colt from a fine family who shaped really well and was unlucky to bump into unmistakably a pattern-class performer when second in a Doncaster novice (1m, heavy) 32 days ago, travelling with plenty of purpose. In leading hands and sure to progress and he's the one to beat.

finals.race: All Weather Championship Is Back EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 2)
finals.comment: Fetched 500,000 gns as a yearling but proved easy to back and shaped as if in need of the experience when sixth of 11 in a Nottingham novice (1m) on debut 6 weeks ago. Not knocked about then and he appeals as a likely improver for his top yard.

finals.race: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Fillies' Handicap
finals.comment: First success since her 2023 debut in France (including a 6-race spell in Ireland for Joseph O'Brien) when striking on her first outing for George Boughey over 8.6f here 3 weeks ago. Has the worst of the draw now dropping back in trip.
